criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 31 July 2027 (12 months after the 31 July 2026 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.
Calculates the working capital shortfall as $620,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $254,380,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $253,760,000 is wrong.
Calculates the long-stop date as 22 August 2026 (120 days after signing on 24 April 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 21 September 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (12 months) and as a date (31 July 2027), with days remaining from 14 May 2026 (443 days).
Notes that 31 July 2027 is a Saturday and that the release moves to the next Business Day, 2 August 2027.
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
